properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured): the idea-linking concept was built for OPEN IDEAS, judged in PAIRS, against a detector that asks only 'connected to anything?'. Requirements and accepted ideas are outside it, nothing gathers pieces under a whole, search never follows a link, and the link suggester compares only same-type records and is swamped by the shared author. A vision spread across 16 records reads as scattered
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL (root-cause, fetched fresh), 2026-10-07, dev_reflow2 hub, on Anthony's /root-cause. He asked whether the one-graph vision (a set of designs worked as one design graph) was "scattered across ten pieces" because those pieces predate the link-ideas concept, or because something is wrong with it.

① OBSERVED, and the first observation was WRONG. The agent had told him nothing tied the pieces together; it had read search hits, which show no edges. MEASURED over 16 vision records on origin/main e72900df5 plus PR #696: 13 edges among them (5 ANTICIPATES, 4 EVOLVES_INTO, 3 DEPENDS_ON, 1 GOVERNED_BY) and 25 cross-references in their text. 13 of the 16 form one connected web. Outside it: req:recursive-black-box-decomposition (08-07; 19 edges, all into the within-one-design decomposition family, none into the across-designs one), req:one-design-or-several-is-asked (07-28; linked to req:design-identity and an acknowledgement only) and req:one-search-reaches-every-design-a-hub-tracks (09-28; only its author and a planned capability). No record names the whole.

② PRECEDENT: dec:idea-do-ideas-form-a-graph-or-only-a-list (08-21, Anthony: "we talked about black-boxes, systems engineering, functional allocation... paint a bigger, more holistic picture... does reflow2 link ideas/concepts or does it rely on the agent?"), settled "ideas form a graph: the brainstorm and link-ideas skills connect them". The link-ideas skill followed on 08-25 (#341). fact:relation-candidates-shared-neighbour-signal-is-dominated-by-the-author-edge (09-22) measured that an edge does nothing for search_design and that the suggester's shared-neighbour signal is swamped by the author edge. Nothing followed it.

③–⑤ CANDIDATES AND MEASUREMENTS:
- C1, the pieces predate link-ideas: REFUTED as the cause. Two of the three outliers predate 08-25 (07-28, 08-07), but req:one-search-reaches-every-design-a-hub-tracks is 09-28, after it. No linking pass would have reached any of the three anyway (C2).
- C2, population: CONFIRMED. unreviewed_ideas (relate.rs) scans Decision nodes at status `proposed` only. All three outliers are Requirements, and an idea leaves the population the moment it is accepted.
- C3, threshold: CONFIRMED. One review relation of any kind clears an idea; the question is "connected to anything?", not "connected to its family?".
- C4, shape: SUPPORTED. The link-ideas skill judges pairs and has no step that gathers pieces under a whole. The vocabulary could express one (a parent Requirement, DECOMPOSES), but nothing prompts it.
- C5, capture: CONFIRMED as a missing step. capture-intent draws one link, EVOLVES_INTO from the idea a requirement came from, and add_requirement takes no related_to. Whether the agent that captured the 09-28 requirement would have linked it if asked cannot be told apart.
- C6, observation wrong: CONFIRMED, see ①.
- C7, retrieval: CONFIRMED. search.rs reads edges only for INVALIDATES. A linked family still comes back as separate hits, which is what made it look scattered.
- C8, found while measuring: relation_candidates builds its pool from the subject's own node type unless pool_type is passed (neighbourhood.rs). A requirement is compared with 354 requirements and never with ideas, and the top reason is still "both relate to who:ajs". For the 09-28 requirement, 1 of 10 suggestions was in the family; for black-box, 0 of 10.

⑥ CLASS: Anthony's 08-21 need (the pieces of one picture are found together) was implemented as a narrower one (no OPEN IDEA floats alone). The narrowing sits in four places: population (open ideas only), shape (pairs, no whole), retrieval (links never change what search returns) and suggestion quality (same-type pool, author-dominated). The 09-22 finding saw two of them and was recorded with no follow-through. Each later "we discussed this before" moment is the same class: fact:root-cause-a-sibling-designs-precedent-was-surfaced-three-times-and-never-read-2026-09-28, the 09-22 question, today.

FIX OPTIONS, NONE CHOSEN (Anthony's call):
- F1: widen the detector to unlinked INTENT, i.e. requirements and accepted ideas with no relation beyond author, project or satisfaction.
- F2: fix the suggester. Discount ubiquitous neighbours (the author, the project) the way rare terms are already weighted, and pool ideas with requirements when the subject is intent.
- F3: search returns each hit's directly related intent, one hop, so a family comes back together.
- F4: link-ideas, brainstorm and capture-intent ask whether a new piece belongs under a recorded whole, and link it there.
- F5: capture-intent offers relation_candidates after a requirement is written.
The umbrella this session records (req:a-set-of-designs-that-make-up-one-system-is-worked-as-one-design-graph) is F4 done by hand once.

⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED: whether a linking pass ever ran over these records; agent lapse versus missing step at the 09-28 capture (C5); suggestion quality is measured on two subjects only.
